name: ClaimWatch
description: RL environment for insurance claims triage

paragraphs: ClaimWatch is an OpenEnv-compatible reinforcement learning environment for insurance claims triage. It models the operational problem faced by payers and utilization-management teams: every claim is a routing decision under time pressure, reviewer capacity constraints, documentation uncertainty, fraud risk, and changing policy rules.
This is a strong reinforcement learning use case because the agent is optimizing a sequence of decisions, not a single label.
RL is the right tool here because the environment has:
features: delayed consequences through SLA misses and capacity depletion
constrained resources such as physician and clinical-review slots
non-stationarity through policy changes in harder tasks
competing objectives: accuracy, speed, fraud detection, and avoidance of false denials
